reports.fvg_mitigation_rule: Intersection (touch / entry overlap): low <= upper AND high >= lower. Full mitigation (bullish FVG): low <= lower (price traded through the entire gap to/through the FVG floor; a candle entirely below the zone also counts). Full mitigation (bearish FVG): high >= upper (price traded through the entire gap to/through the FVG ceiling; a candle entirely above also counts). An FVG starts unmitigated at Candle-3 close. Mitigation is evaluated on subsequent candles only (formation candle excluded). Once fully mitigated, the FVG cannot generate later entries.
